bio.text: Nate Willems, a Democrat and attorney, announced in May 2025 that he was running for Iowa attorney general in 2026, according to KCRG.
KCRG reported that he is a native of Anamosa living in Mount Vernon who served two terms in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2008 to 2012.
KCRG also reported that he is an attorney with Rush & Nicholson, P.L.C., in Cedar Rapids.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Democratic nominee for Iowa attorney general in the November 3, 2026 election.

sources.title: Willems announces campaign for Iowa attorney general
